newsitem.title: CHINA: One-night stand costs HK man two years in jail.
newsitem.headline: One-night stand costs HK man two years in jail.

text.p: A one-night stand gone wrong has cost a Hong Kong man two years in jail after 10 years on the run, a local newspaper reported on Saturday.
Former journalist Kwong Yiu-hong spent a decade evading loan sharks after a night of passion with a woman in Macau developed into a huge debt.
Kwong, now a housing estate manager, was sentenced to two years in jail for stealing more than HK$1.4 million from his employer, the South China Morning Post reported.
The strange tale began in 1986 when Kwong agreed to act as a sponsor for a HK$200,000 loan for a woman he had just met. By 1993, the debt had grown to HK$1.5 million and the woman was long gone.
The 58-year old father of four said he agreed to help the woman because of her "beauty and seduction". The pact included a one-night tryst with the woman.
